name: Toxe
description: '''Tove Agélii''', known as '''Toxe''', is a Swedish music producer and singer. She began her career in 2015 by posting her music to [[SoundCloud]]. She has since released two [[Extended play|extended plays]]; ''Muscle Memory'' (2015) and ''Blinks'' (2018), an original soundtrack 'The Story Of Leonora' (2023), and her debut solo album; ''Toxe2'' (2024).
